title: LZ Carry Hero Portrait Register
policy: No game character artwork is embedded or remotely loaded until LZ Carry has written redistribution/display permission from the rights holder or a source-specific license that expressly permits this website's use. Publisher-owned game art remains publisher content. Community wiki, database, social-media and app-store images are not assumed reusable.
presentation: Consistent portrait frame: 4:5 aspect ratio, object-fit: cover, centered face crop; use a licensed 512x640 WebP/AVIF derivative with an accessible original-name alt text. Until cleared, render the branded initials placeholder.
